name: 【底辺チューバーからの脱却】名 を たくさん 伝えれる 画期的ツール
description: A rhythm game where you pronounce the Japanese character 'な' (na) to the beat of a 175 BPM song. Features combos & fever mode, 25 kinds of 'な' effects with rarity tiers (gold/diamond 'な' are clickable for bonuses), a dancing 3D character (Shiashia) with manga-style cut-ins, 35 achievements, and 14 random endings with animations.
